An '''atrisian corps''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. It was named in honor of the ancient [[Atrisian]] warriors of the [[Kitel Phard Dynasty]].<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

==Organization==
An atrisian [[Corps/Legends|corps]] was comprised of two [[reinforced battlegroup]]s, a [[line battlegroup]], an [[armored battlegroup]], an [[auxiliary battlegroup]], and [[Corps/Legends#Corps HQs|corps headquarters]]. It included 48,403 personnel, 3,385 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], and 795 [[Tank|heavy tanks]].<ref name="ISB" />

Atrisian corps could be augmented by the addition of a [[mobile battlegroup]], a reinforced battlegroup, an [[armored battlegroup]], and a line battlegroup.<ref name="ISB2" />
